description: This PHP class 'RestoreDatabaseToSavepointController' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the 'FunctionalTesting' module. It defines a controller responsible for restoring the database to a specified savepoint during functional testing, handling HTTP requests and returning responses with the result.

classes.name: RestoreDatabaseToSavepointController
classes.description: Controller handling HTTP requests to restore database to a savepoint during functional testing, implementing PublicControllerInterface.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP request to restore database to a specified savepoint and returns a JSON response with the count of tables restored.
